identity.admin_sid_source: local read-only resolution; user confirmation required before C00/C02

path_policy.unlisted_read: content read and listing denied and recorded; a successful read of a deny root is fatal
layering: trusted_load (dispatcher): exact manifest, dispatcher, dependencies, tool bytes and node.exe; hashed before load
business: exact data inputs + exact process-entry/guard/audit files listed in load_files; no tool directory read
control (p0-audit.cjs): chain tail/append + own segment parts/summary; never business data
product (runner child): copy subtree + own OUT dir; exclusive write list
path_policy.overlap_rule: a path may appear in at most one of read_allow and deny_read for the same layer; checked in both directions
path_policy.acl_exception: acl-set-recursive is a metadata write; it may traverse protected paths but must not change content and must be verified by SDDL readback (C02 only)

temp_policy.rule: a redirected TEMP/TMP must be covered by a read and a write entry of the same layer; forbidden means no temp write is permitted; inherited is disclosed as out-of-contract

readers.C18-E01: reads the destination and verifies the file hash against segment_open
readers.C19-E01: records the file hash in index.json
readers.C20-REPORT-E01: consumes the chain record; re-hashes the file if present
readers.C20-SEAL-E01: verifies the file hash against segment_open if present

anchors.what: inline command text of C00-E01 and C03-PROBE-E01
P0_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_SID, P0_CODEX_ACCOUNT, P0_TOOLSRC_MANIFEST_SHA256, RUN_ID, quiet window

anchors.when: before C00; rechecked by C00, C05-PRE, C05-FINAL, C20-SEAL

trust.staged_first_use: C05-FINAL uses the source dispatcher and verifies the staged tree; C06 first executes the staged dispatcher
trust.c00_role: fail-fast gate, not a trust root; H3 is external
trust.load_stability: dispatcher hashes each tool from a handle opened with FileShare.Read (deny write/delete), keeps the handle open until the child is created, and rechecks after exit; the residual verify-to-map window is UNVERIFIED and depends on the C02 ACL
trust.manifest_hash_source: all tool hashes are null and MUST come from the approved RELEASE-MANIFEST.json

audit.chain_writer: p0-audit.cjs control modes, spawned by p0-dispatch.ps1, account WENX\Administrator
audit.line_bytes: every chain record is written as canonical JSON + LF; prev_file_bytes counts the LF

when_bound: C18-BIND-E01 segment_open records c18_state=bound, c18_binding_sha256, c18_destination
the bound order includes the C18 trio; C18-E01 writes only c18_destination
when_unbound: C18-BIND-E01 segment_open records c18_state=disabled-unbound, binding fields null
the unbound order omits the C18 trio; any plan that includes it records segment_skip(reason=c18-unbound)

flow.model: structured requirements + terminal states + stop levels + seal function

requirement_states.ok: the referenced execution must have closed ok
requirement_states.terminal: the referenced execution must have closed ok|failed|aborted
requirement_states.recorded: the referenced execution must have any chain record, including segment_skip (a skipped target is a valid terminal state for reporting)
requirement_states.settled: the referenced execution reached any terminal state; used for binding hand-off ordering

flow.no_pending: the dispatcher appends a segment_skip for every planned execution that did not run; a hard dispatcher death leaves an open tail, which the seal lists as orphaned instead of inventing a close
flow.mandatory_after: a wrapped target that started and failed still gets exactly one C07-A; a skipped target never gets before/after evidence
flow.seal_function: mode = no-chain if genesis missing; seal-failed if C20-SEAL failed; chain-broken if chain integrity failed; degraded-prefix if staged_state != complete; aborted if the run halted; else sealed-full

chain-broken.condition: chain tail/prev/digest cannot be verified, or C19 fails a chain-integrity check
chain-broken.output: no terminal-seal.json is written; operator records chain-broken

no-chain.condition: C01 did not close ok; genesis or the chain file is absent
no-chain.output: launch record only; no chain records, no seal

seal-failed.output: no retry; console + launch record; partial seal is not authoritative

degraded-prefix.condition: staged_state=incomplete|absent and the chain is intact
degraded-prefix.output: seal lists the actual prefix, missing items and open segments; no full recheck claim

aborted.condition: staged_state=complete and the run halted at a recorded abort point
aborted.output: seal lists abort exec, failure class/trigger, open segments, skipped/not-started

sealed-full.condition: staged_state=complete and the run reached the terminal plan end
sealed-full.output: full staged recheck; exit_status=complete only when no failed/skipped exec, C18 bound

failure_policy.security_priority: security > fatal > gate > informational; a security-class failure stops the run even if the execution default class is gate

halt-business: pending C07-A for a started failed target
halt-all: pending C07-A for a started failed target

failure_policy.observer_reclaim: if PROBE fails or exceeds 300 s, the operator terminates it; OBS receives EOF and must close its segment as failed within 900 s; if OBS does not exit, the dispatcher kills it and records observer-reclaimed before any C04

publish.commit_point: CURRENT.json rename after every materialised file matches the immutable release index
publish.same_volume: release, staging and package root share one NTFS volume; per-file replace uses temp+rename (MoveFileEx replace-existing)
not_claimed: protection against an external process modifying the tree during the switch
